game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Moss Door Chamber Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber, a mossy sealed door: the shadow ranger must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Moss Door Chamber: a mossy sealed door
core_gameplay_loop: In Moss Door Chamber, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about belt_count to power up the shadow ranger and open the supply cache.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
